hypothesis: On the immutable 35c9 dense base at matrix LR 0.015, the last-layer 64x128 BF16 bigram+trigram value-embedding subsystem improves same-host trn21 fresh 2M public BPB by at least 0.001 and therefore merits the downstream two-host full20M evaluation path.
single_causal_change: Replace --no-ngram-ve with the complete A1 subsystem configuration: --ngram-ve --ngram-ve-layers=-1 --ngram-ve-table-mult 64 --ngram-ve-dim 128 --ngram-ve-trigram --ngram-ve-opt rmsprop --ngram-ve-flat-lr --ngram-ve-bf16 --ngram-ve-clip-exclude.

control.box_constraint: A1 compares only with this fresh same-host trn21 control; cross-host throughput claims are forbidden.

candidate.expected_diff: No train.py change. A1 is expressed entirely by the explicit launch flag subsystem configuration against immutable 35c9 bytes.

screening.selection_authority: The A1 2M screen may nominate or discard only. It can never KEEP or adopt A1 by itself, and an other-host full20M replicate alone is not confirmation.

downstream_adoption.metric_population: fresh public BPB at seq_len=1024, num_tokens=20,971,520 and num_bytes=83,462,186
downstream_adoption.delta_definition: candidate full20M BPB minus authenticated same-host control full20M BPB
downstream_adoption.required_deltas: One matched trn21 delta and one matched trn22 delta; both must be strictly negative.
downstream_adoption.mean_gate: Arithmetic mean of the two Decimal deltas must be <= -0.001.

disk_and_artifact_policy.process_group_policy: Every subprocess is launched in a private session under a verified child subreaper. Any group member remaining after the leader exits makes the arm fail; bounded TERM then KILL must yield a nonexistent group before any checkpoint or success-artifact hash.
disk_and_artifact_policy.control_checkpoint_retention: Retain both control checkpoints for fresh 20M and finalist analysis.
disk_and_artifact_policy.a1_checkpoint_retention: Retain A1 checkpoint through evidence archival and, if nominated, through its trn21 fresh20M evaluation and the matched trn22 full20M replicate/adoption decision.
disk_and_artifact_policy.retrieval: Retrieve and hash every preflight/job/process/postflight log, training/eval log, finite receipt, cache observation, result, archive, manifest, completion receipt, and checkpoint identity before any later lifecycle action.

authorization_model.core: Immutable science source identities, proposal, driver, launcher adapter, contracts, and tests are frozen in a core commit.
authorization_model.finalization: Only the three request/auth pairs may differ after the core. Control requests may be externally verified immediately; A1 authorization remains invalid until exact archived trn21 control Git-blob digests are bound.
authorization_model.runtime: The adapter derives the externally verified finalization HEAD, writes an O_EXCL concrete standard-launcher request, and the job revalidates Git/worktree/request/runtime/source/evidence identities before work.
authorization_model.evidence: A1 accepts only exact-schema regular Git blobs from an authorization-pinned archive commit; symlink/tree-mode, digest, member, tar, metric, checkpoint, host, or label mismatches fail closed.

success_criteria.quality: A1 nomination only when its exact fresh2M BPB is at least 0.001 below authenticated same-host trn21 control. Adoption later requires matched fresh20M candidate-minus-control deltas on trn21 and trn22 to both be negative and their Decimal mean to be <= -0.001; the other-host replicate alone is not confirmation.
success_criteria.throughput: Diagnostic only and same-host only; no cross-host rate claim.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact 35c9/prepare bytes, exact arm argv, seed42, LNC2/world4, full1800, no smoke, finite weights-only checkpoint, exact fresh2M token/byte counts, sealed evidence, and no budget/causality/dirty-tree failure.

abort_conditions: Any train.py or prepare.py byte differs from its pinned identity
Any command, environment, request, runtime job, protected source, or evidence fingerprint differs
A host is not clean/idle, already owns a run, or has less than 6.5 GiB free; less than 5 GiB is a hard abort
A1 lacks the exact authenticated archived same-host trn21 control
Any smoke, shortened run, automatic cache cleanup, checkpoint prune, direct KEEP/adopt, or submission is requested
Crash, NaN, timeout, over-budget result, missing/nonfinite checkpoint, causality failure, dirty tree, or artifact mutation
Fresh2M reports counts other than 2,097,152 tokens and 8,418,678 bytes
